mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates by signaling persistent monetary accommodation, directly increasing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in lower cost of capital.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market deterioration that typically precedes corporate earnings contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
